evidence_snippets: Pricing for Cloud SQL depends on your instance type: MySQL and PostgreSQL SQL Server MySQL and PostgreSQL pricing Cloud SQL pricing is composed of the following charges: CPU and memory pricing Storage and networking pricing Instance pricing Cloud DNS pricing Extended support pricing CPU and memory pricing For dedicated-core instances, you choose the number of CPUs and the amount of memory you want, up to 96 CPUs and 624 GiB of memory for Enterprise edition and up to 128 CPUs and 864 GiB of memory for Enterprise Plus edition.

For Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus edition for SQL Server instances, you can also choose from performance-optimized machines (up to 128 CPUs and 864 GiB of memory) and memory-optimized machines (up to 16 CPUs and 512 GiB of memory).
